description: A spot in the flat list of every location, with the save that names it.

said.description: The caption's (or the video's) own words for it.
said.title: Said

near.description: The town, park or area it sits in.
near.title: Near

lat.description: Latitude, from OpenStreetMap, or from Overture Maps when `overture` is set. Only when `exact`.
lat.title: Lat

lon.description: Longitude, from the same source as `lat`. Only when `exact`.
lon.title: Lon

wikidata.description: Wikidata id, when OpenStreetMap has one.
wikidata.title: Wikidata

map.description: A Google Maps link: the exact place when its place id is kept, else a search for the name in its town.
map.title: Map

google_id.description: Google's place id, when one is kept. Nothing else of Google's is kept.
google_id.title: Google Id

overture.description: Overture Maps' place id, when the position is from Overture's open places data. Show its credit with it.
overture.title: Overture

overture_release.description: The Overture release the position was read from, such as 2026-09-23.1. Only with `overture`.
overture_release.title: Overture Release

licence.description: The Overture row's licence: CDLA-Permissive-2.0, or Apache-2.0 for rows from Foursquare. Only with `overture`.
licence.title: Licence

exact.description: True when pinned at the spot itself; false when no open map lists it and it stands at its town (no lat/lon then).
exact.title: Exact

listed.description: True when no source places it and no Google id is kept: list it under its town, not on a map. Only when `exact` is false.
listed.title: Listed

still.description: A still from the video, a path in the media folder.
still.title: Still

clip.description: A 3 second clip, a path in the media folder.
clip.title: Clip

t.description: Seconds into the video where the still is.
t.title: T

still_from.description: name: the spot's name is on screen; area: a shot of its area.
still_from.title: Still From

area.description: The area the still shows, when still_from is area.
area.title: Area

km_away.description: How far it is, in km, when the search was within km of a point or a Google place.
km_away.title: Km Away

title: SpotAt
